verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a broad public API covering enrichments, dataset building, scrapes, quick searches, and search agents. It adds an official Go SDK, an MCP server, and webhooks, so most core workflows can be run programmatically. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows UI parity, though: scheduled monitoring and refresh features appear only on the marketing site, with no documented API endpoint. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of scheduling/monitoring projects, evidence of project/account management via the API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Riveter API lets you enrich data, build datasets, scrape webpages, quickly search the web, and extract data from complicated websites programmatically.
Official Go SDK for the Riveter API — enrich data, build datasets, scrape pages, and run web searches.
